position: Head of IT and Information Security
matching_criteria: Current/most recent role = head of the information-security function (CISO / директор, руководитель/начальник службы, отдела, управления ИБ) or combined IT+IS head, leading a team, in fintech/bigtech/tech employers. Heads of a sub-part of IS or deputies = medium. Pure IT-only heads, IS consultants/integrator practices, non-tech employers (energy, oil, state, manufacturing, retail) and hidden employers without industry excluded.
